references.text: Describes the linen garments that the priests were to wear, including linen undergarments, which Aaron also wore in the sanctuary.
Aaron and his sons were brought to the entrance of the tent of meeting and washed with water before being clothed in the priestly garments.
Describes the holy linen garments that Aaron was to put on before entering the sanctuary on the Day of Atonement.
Reiterates that the priest must wear the holy linen garments when performing the atonement ritual.
Ezekiel's vision concerning the priests who are to wear linen garments in the inner court and change their clothes before going out to the people.
